# EaseAbroad

EaseAbroad is an AI trip planner covering 400+ curated cities. Plan day-by-day trips with Auto Plan, discover live events during your travel dates via Ticketmaster and SeatGeek, enjoy hands-free GPS audio walking tours, and gift client itineraries as a travel agency.

## Key features

- Auto Plan day-by-day itineraries across 400+ cities
- Live events matched to your travel dates (Ticketmaster & SeatGeek)
- Hands-free GPS audio walking tours
- Multi-city day maps with timed stops
- Travel-agency trip gifting

## Official URLs

- Site: https://easeabroad.app/

Available on Android (Google Play) and the web.
